system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Arcana

You have the talent and training necessary to use one of the Traditions of magic and are able to shape arcane energy into powerful spells.

Choose a magical Tradition that you would have access to. You can now cast spells from that Tradition, as well as those that can be cast by Any tradition.

Then, choose 5 spells to learn from a combination of your chosen Tradition and those that can be cast by Any tradition.

You can learn more spells as a downtime activity, or with the appropriate roleplay.

Provided you meet the requirements, you can also invest additional XP into this ability to learn additional Traditions.

If you do so, you immediately learn 1 spell from that Tradition.

Additionally, you can perform minor, non-combat effects with objects related to your chosen Tradition. For example, a Fire mage might change the color or shape of a flame, while an Earth mage might carve tiny figures from stone.

The requirements for additional Traditions are listed below:

  • 2nd Tradition

    • +2 XP

    • Training (2) or Expertise (2) in the Arcana Skill

  • 3rd Tradition

    • +3 XP

    • Training (2) and Expertise (2) in the Arcana Skill

  • 4th Tradition

    • +4 XP

    • Training (3) or Expertise (3) in the Arcana Skill

  • 5th Tradition

    • +5 XP

    • Training (3) and Expertise (3) in the Arcana Skill

  • 6th Tradition

    • +6 XP

    • Mind 6

  • 7th Tradition

    • + 7 XP

    • Mind 7

  • 8th Tradition

    • + 8 XP

    • Mind 8
